articles.summary: Formal presentation begins today, October 6, 2026, at 11 a.m. ET OmniAb, Inc. (NASDAQ: OABI), a provider of cutting-edge discovery research technology to enable the discovery of next-generation therapeutics, today hosts its Investor Analyst Day in Emeryville, CA. With a full presentation agenda, the event highlights recent partner developments, the broader roll out of the xPloration® platform, and introduces the OmniTides™ peptide discovery platform and brand. “We look forward to bringing together our investment community and sharing a closer look at our technologies and capabilities, our strategy and the exciting opportunities ahead,” said Matt Foehr, Chief Executive Officer of OmniAb. “At our Investor Analyst Day, we have the opportunity to discuss our priorities and our plans related to our increasingly efficient business model, review the variety of ways we are creating value with technology licensing, and outline how we are positioning the company for sustainable,
articles.title: OmniAb Highlights Partner Pipeline, xPloration® Plans and Outlook, and Introduces the OmniTides™ Platform at Investor & Analyst Day
